# Experiment DLG-EXP-008 of docs/spec/dialog.md, section 16: payload length.
# Source: the log of the vanilla server. Each line reports the end of one raw connection. The
# connection sends custom_click_action. The name of the player is the label of the case. The
# saved logs do not hold the packet that each case sent, nor the meaning of the label.
# "lost connection: Disconnected" means that the client closed the connection.
# A case that has "Failed to decode packet" has a packet that the server rejects.
# Lines that start with "# " are notes of the fixture. The other lines are the raw log lines.
# Two edits: the UUID of each connection is replaced with <uuid>, and the name of the exception
# class is replaced with <decode error>.
#
